mentions.name: Flow Break
mentions.description: A reimagined Pomodoro ("tomato method") alarm/timer app that uses computer vision to detect when the user is sitting and exposes stats for AI agent analysis.
mentions.problem: Difficulty stopping coding sessions (vibe coding) and taking breaks
mentions.audience: People who get absorbed in long coding sessions and struggle to take breaks
mentions.source_excerpt: That’s why I have shipped the flow break app that’s a reimagined tomato method alarm/timer. It uses computer vision to detect your sitting and can expose stats for agent to analysis.
mentions.author: hamxiaoz
